name: Viper-V6
source:
Viper V-6 is the first in the long-running Viper series of animated adult games. It contains three separate stories:

1. "The Devil Came" tells the story of a teenager named Ogawa, who was unpopular in his class and summoned a demon to exact revenge. But the demon turned out to be female, so his wishes naturally assume a different direction.

2. "Afternoon" describes a scene during a beauty contest. The defeated participant thinks that she was unfairly judged, but her fury at the winner turns, in front of the amazed spectators, into erotic desire.

3. "Double Impact" features two young female detectives who, at the request of a client, aimed to infiltrate a mansion to solve the mysterious disappearances taking place there.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/43486/viper-v6/]Moby Games[/url]]

NOTE: "Afternoon" is replaced with "Alien War" from V8 in the "V6 R" edition in 2003.

- "Alien War" takes place in the future. A young female space pilot is captured by aliens of the enemy camp.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/43488/viper-v8/]Moby Games[/url]]
